entries.oldClaim: You must make 20 successful API calls in the demo environment before Go-Live.
entries.currentFact: DocuSign eliminated the 20-API-call requirement in its streamlined Go-Live experience. Older threads and integrator docs still cite it.

entries.oldClaim: A Marketplace listing needs 5 active workspace installs.
entries.currentFact: The requirement is 10 active-workspace installs since July 2026, and it must be maintained during review.
Xero's 2026 pricing pages list connection tiers (5/50/1,000/10,000) and do not mention 25; third-party docs still cite 25.
Google's FAQ says 10 business days; another Google page reportedly says 3–5 but we did not capture its URL. Clearance uses 10.

entries.oldClaim: Unlisted apps get the same Tier 3 limits as Marketplace apps (still shown on the method's reference page).
entries.currentFact: Since May 29 2025, non-Marketplace commercial apps are limited to 1 request per minute on conversations.history and conversations.replies, with a maximum page size of 15. Whether existing installs are affected is disputed.
